messages:
ashley.ng: Hey @people-ops — my direct deposit this morning is ~30% lower than expected. I moved from OR -> WA on 2026-02-15 and updated address in ADP, but payrun shows OR state tax withheld. Net is down ~$320. Can someone check? Payrun id: `PR-2026-03-15-8347`

maria.hr: @jack.payroll can you pull that run and confirm which state code was used? Ashley, did you submit a new W-4 or state withholding form when you moved?

ashley.ng: I updated home address 2/16 and uploaded WA DL to the portal. I didn’t change federal W-4 (still single, 0). I thought WA is no state income tax so shouldn't be any state withholding.

payroll-bot: PR-2026-03-15-8347 processed 2026-03-15 07:12 UTC. Employee state code on file: OR. Federal withholding and SS/Medicare as expected. (Automated payroll note)

jack.payroll: Thanks. On it — looks like the address change landed in HRIS but didn't sync to payroll before the batch cut. I’ll open a ticket with our vendor and see if we can do an off-cycle net adjustment. @leo.finance fyi for potential retro/expense booking.

leo.finance: If vendor can refund the miswithheld state tax we'll do an off-cycle to top up net. If not, fallback is a W-2c next year but we'd prefer fix now. Need gross & state withheld amounts from Ashley.

ashley.ng: Gross for the period was $6,200. State (OR) withheld $410. WA should be $0. Bank deposit posted this AM. Screenshot of paystub attached in the portal.

jack.payroll: Got it. Creating vendor ticket and requesting expedited refund: ticket PAY-4482 created. Asking for approval for an off-cycle payment of +$410 net to reverse state withholding. Also confirming employment classification — you're W-2 employee (not contractor), right?

ashley.ng: Correct, W-2.

maria.hr: I uploaded the ADP address-change confirmation and the WA license scan to PAY-4482 thread. Also flagged employee record to block any more OR withholding until the vendor confirms. :thumbsup:

payroll-bot: Ticket PAY-4482 logged. SLA: 72 hours. Current status: vendor triage.

jack.payroll: Vendor estimated 2-3 business days. If they approve refund we'll schedule off-cycle on next Tue; otherwise we'll process a manual reversal in the following run and handle accounting. If neither is possible, we will issue a W-2c. I’ll update this thread as soon as I hear back.

ashley.ng: Thanks — appreciate the quick follow-up. Please ping me if you need any more docs.

maria.hr: For visibility: Ashley, please double-check your paystub on the portal (Compensation > Pay > PR-2026-03-15-8347) and confirm the banking last 4 digits. We flagged your future runs to WA state code.

jack.payroll: Posted vendor ticket link in the HRIS ticket. Will update here when PAY-4482 moves.

leo.finance: Noted for month-end accruals — hold expense code "miswithhold_retro" until confirmed.

payroll-bot: Next update expected by 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC.
